```{r}
metadata_rd <- metadata |>
  filter(str_ends(SampleID, "1|2")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = where(is.numeric), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  reframe(
    mean = round(mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    max  = round(max(value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min  = round(min(value, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  )
```

##### Normalize count table by total gene lengths by genome

```{r count-table-normalization, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE}
dbmd <- read.table(here::here("data/masterMD4DB.txt"))

gene_lengts_by_genome <- read.table(
  here::here("data/gene_lengths_by_genome.csv"),
  row.names = 1, header = T, sep = ",", check.names = F)

only_curto_gl <- gene_lengts_by_genome |>
  dplyr::select(any_of(as.data.frame(tax) |>
                         dplyr::filter(genus == "Curtobacterium") |>
                         row.names()))

colnames(gene_lengts_by_genome) <- dbmd$V4[match(colnames(gene_lengts_by_genome), dbmd$V3)]

genome_names <- colnames(gene_lengts_by_genome)
strain_names <- rownames(data)

missing_in_gene_lengths <- setdiff(strain_names, genome_names)
missing_in_counts       <- setdiff(genome_names, strain_names)
cat("Strains missing in gene_lengths:\n"); print(missing_in_gene_lengths)
cat("Genomes missing in counts:\n");       print(missing_in_counts)

data <- data[!rownames(data) %in% missing_in_gene_lengths, ]

total_gene_lengths <- colSums(gene_lengts_by_genome)
total_gene_lengths <- total_gene_lengths[rownames(data)]
all.equal(names(total_gene_lengths), rownames(data))

rpk_table <- round(sweep(data, 1, total_gene_lengths, FUN = "/") * 1e6)
sort(colSums(rpk_table))
```

#### Create phyloseq object

```{r create-phyloseq, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE}
row.names(metadata) <- metadata$SampleID
metadata <- metadata[, -5]

missing_samples <- union(setdiff(rownames(metadata), colnames(rpk_table)),
                         setdiff(colnames(rpk_table), rownames(metadata)))
metadata <- metadata %>% filter(!(rownames(.) %in% missing_samples))

count_table <- otu_table(rpk_table, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
tax         <- as.matrix(tax)
taxonomy    <- tax_table(tax)
sam_data    <- sample_data(metadata)
mg          <- phyloseq(count_table, taxonomy, sam_data)
mg

# tax table as data frame for later use
tax <- as.data.frame(tax)

sam_data_df <- data.frame(mg@sam_data) |>
  dplyr::mutate(merging_id = case_when(
    grepl("3$", SampleID) ~ sub("3$", "1", SampleID),
    grepl("4$", SampleID) ~ sub("4$", "2", SampleID),
    TRUE ~ SampleID
  ))
mg@sam_data <- sample_data(sam_data_df)

mg_mer <- merge_samples(mg, group = "merging_id", fun = mean)

otu_matrix  <- as.matrix(t(otu_table(mg_mer)))
otu_averaged <- apply(otu_matrix, 2, function(x) round(x / 2))
otu_averaged <- otu_averaged[, colnames(otu_matrix)]
otu_table(mg_mer) <- otu_table(otu_averaged, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
print(otu_table(mg_mer))

mgmer_SDtemp <- data.frame(mg_mer@sam_data) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(reserve_litter,
                   Reserve,
                   SampleID,
                   Ecosystem,
                   Litter_type,
                   Litter_species,
                   Litter_species_common_name,
                   Plant_family,
                   Plant_type,
                   reserve_code,
                   crude_protein,
                   cellulose,
                   hemicellulose,
                   Structural_Carbohydrates,
                   lignin,
                   merging_id)) %>%
  merge(., litter_md |> dplyr::select(-c(plot_cordsX, plot_cordsY, Elevation, pH)),
        by = "row.names") %>%
  mutate(reserve_litter = paste(reserve_code, Litter_type, sep = "-")) |>
  column_to_rownames("Row.names")
colnames(mgmer_SDtemp) <- gsub("\\.", " ", colnames(mgmer_SDtemp))
print(colnames(mgmer_SDtemp))

sample_data(mg_mer) <- mgmer_SDtemp
mg <- mg_mer
rm(mgmer_SDtemp)
```

